title: So far so good!
body: So far, I’m enjoying Fabulous and playing along the way. I find this app everything that I could have imagined and more. It has such a beautiful customizable flavor and it’s like being on a great adventure. Or falling into a storybook, but one I have the power to alter the outcome- whether happy or sad. Who wants a sad ending? I am journeying toward the reward and the treasure. It’s only day 2, however, I’m very excited to find out what happens! It’s way more than an exercise or healthy eating app. The suggestions and prompts are full of soulful reminders and encouragement.
